acute_disseminated_encephalomyelitis_or_.description: Patients with a diagnosis of acute disseminated encephalomyelitis or myelitis.

items.rationale: The SNOMED concept 374021, 'Acute disseminated encephalomyelitis', accurately represents the clinical description of acute disseminated encephalomyelitis. Including descendants ensures that related conditions are also captured.
The SNOMED concept 138965, 'Myelitis', is included to capture a broader range of myelitis diagnoses, as suggested. Including descendants will ensure that various types of myelitis are covered.

acute_disseminated_encephalomyelitis_or_.name: acute_disseminated_encephalomyelitis_or_myelitis

final_spec.question: Identify patients with acute disseminated encephalomyelitis or myelitis based on diagnosis evidence with a qualifying inpatient or inpatient/emergency visit.
